labels.cancelled_note: The run was cancelled by the user; only the items processed before cancellation are reported.
labels.method_text: Each file was opened read-only and hashed in a single pass with the selected algorithms. Its real type was identified from its signature; JPEG, HEIC, PNG and WebP images were then re-read without being modified in an isolated process, and the bytes read were hashed again and compared with the first pass. Every action was written to a hash-chained audit log.
labels.next_ok: No action needed for this file.
labels.next_attention: Review the findings below with your examiner before relying on this file.
labels.next_problem: Do not rely on this file until the examiner has explained the problem.
labels.summary_ok: The file was hashed and checked. The checks applied found no issues.
labels.summary_attention: The file was hashed and checked. Some points need attention.
labels.summary_problem: The file could not be fully examined or shows a serious problem.
labels.fingerprint_text: This fingerprint identifies the exact content of the file. Any change, even of one character, would produce a different value.
labels.timestamp_pending: Pending — the time-stamping service could not be reached; add it later with the timestamp command
labels.not_signed: This PDF is not digitally signed.
labels.item_reports_skipped: Items without report files (--item-reports flagged, no issues found)

EMPTY_FILE.title: Empty file
EMPTY_FILE.shows: The file contains no data (0 bytes).
EMPTY_FILE.does_not_prove: It does not show whether the file was emptied deliberately or created empty.

EXTENSION_MISMATCH.title: Extension does not match content
EXTENSION_MISMATCH.shows: The name ends in .%{extension} but the content starts with the signature of a %{detected} file.
EXTENSION_MISMATCH.does_not_prove: Renaming is common and often innocent; it does not by itself prove an attempt to hide content.

EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.title: Executable content under another name
EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.shows: The content is a %{detected} program although the name ends in .%{extension}.
EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.does_not_prove: It does not show that the program is malicious; analyse it in an isolated environment.

DUPLICATE.title: Duplicate content
DUPLICATE.does_not_prove: Identical hashes show identical content, not who copied the file or when.

UNREADABLE.title: File could not be read
UNREADABLE.does_not_prove: It does not show that the file is damaged; permissions or locks can cause this.

PARSER_FAILED.title: Image analysis did not complete
PARSER_FAILED.shows: The isolated analysis of this file stopped before finishing (reason: %{reason}, exit code %{exit_code}). The file was hashed and its integrity record is complete; the image itself was not fully analysed.
PARSER_FAILED.does_not_prove: It does not show that the file is malicious or manipulated: damaged, unusual or very large images can exhaust the time or memory limits. Re-run with higher limits or examine the file manually.

EVIDENCE_CHANGED_DURING_ANALYSIS.title: Evidence changed during the analysis
EVIDENCE_CHANGED_DURING_ANALYSIS.shows: The bytes read for the image analysis have %{algorithm} %{second_pass}, but the hashing pass recorded %{first_pass} for the same file: the file changed between the two reads, so the analysis results may not describe the hashed evidence.
EVIDENCE_CHANGED_DURING_ANALYSIS.does_not_prove: Who or what changed the file (synchronisation software, antivirus, another program or a failing disk can all do it) or that the original evidence is altered; work on a write-protected copy and repeat the run.

ANALYSIS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.title: Image analyses not yet implemented
ANALYSIS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.shows: This build of the tool hashed the image, checked its file type and re-read it in an isolated process, but the image analyses (structure and metadata checks, quantization-table fingerprints, error level and noise maps, copy-move detection, comparison with reference images) are planned and were not run.
ANALYSIS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.does_not_prove: Nothing about the image's authenticity, in either direction: no signal of modification was looked for.

EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.title: Differs from the evidence registered in the case
EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.shows: The %{algorithm} of this file is %{actual}, but evidence %{evidence_id} was registered at intake with %{expected}: the file examined is not bit-identical to the registered item.
EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.does_not_prove: Who changed the file, when, or whether the change was deliberate; the analysis still ran so the examiner can decide.

EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.title: Not registered in the case
EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.shows: No item of case %{case_id} was registered with this path or this content, so its continuity from intake cannot be shown.
EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.does_not_prove: That the file is altered or irrelevant; it may simply not have gone through intake.

REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.title: Registered path now holds different content
REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.shows: This path was registered earlier as %{previous_id} with other content; the current content gets a new evidence ID.
REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.does_not_prove: Which version is the original or why the content changed.

JPEG_MARKER_ORDER_UNUSUAL.title: Unusual JPEG segment order
JPEG_MARKER_ORDER_UNUSUAL.shows: The segments are written in the order %{sequence}; %{expected}.
JPEG_MARKER_ORDER_UNUSUAL.does_not_prove: Software differs in how it writes JPEG headers; an unusual order shows which kind of program saved the file last, not that the picture was changed.

DUPLICATE_TABLES.title: Tables defined twice
DUPLICATE_TABLES.shows: %{kind} table(s) %{ids} are defined more than once in the file.
DUPLICATE_TABLES.does_not_prove: Some encoders repeat tables legitimately; it does not show which content was encoded with which table.

DATA_AFTER_END_MARKER.title: Data after the end of the image
DATA_AFTER_END_MARKER.shows: %{bytes} bytes follow the end marker of the %{format} image.
DATA_AFTER_END_MARKER.does_not_prove: Phones store extra pictures (depth maps, multi-picture files) after the main image; extra data is not by itself hidden or altered content. Examine it separately.

PROGRESSIVE_ENCODING.title: Progressive JPEG
PROGRESSIVE_ENCODING.shows: The image is encoded as a progressive JPEG.
PROGRESSIVE_ENCODING.does_not_prove: Cameras usually write baseline JPEGs, web tools and editors often write progressive ones; it shows how the file was last encoded, not that the content was changed.

PNG_CHUNK_ORDER_INVALID.title: PNG chunks out of the required order
PNG_CHUNK_ORDER_INVALID.shows: The PNG specification's ordering rules are broken: %{problems}.
PNG_CHUNK_ORDER_INVALID.does_not_prove: It shows the file was written by non-conforming software or edited at byte level; it does not show what changed in the picture.

PNG_PRIVATE_CHUNKS.title: Private PNG chunks
PNG_PRIVATE_CHUNKS.does_not_prove: Many applications add private chunks (Apple, Adobe, screenshot tools); they identify software, not changes.

WEBP_FLAGS_MISMATCH.title: WebP header does not match its content
WEBP_FLAGS_MISMATCH.shows: The WebP extended header and the chunks disagree: %{problems}.
WEBP_FLAGS_MISMATCH.does_not_prove: It shows the file was rewritten or assembled by a tool that did not update the header; it does not show what changed in the picture.

HEIF_STRUCTURE_ANOMALY.title: Unusual HEIC/HEIF structure
HEIF_STRUCTURE_ANOMALY.shows: The box structure differs from what HEIF writers normally produce: %{problems}.
HEIF_STRUCTURE_ANOMALY.does_not_prove: HEIF writers vary between phone models and software versions; this shows how the file is built, not that the picture was altered.

HEIF_UNREFERENCED_DATA.title: HEIC/HEIF bytes used by no item
HEIF_UNREFERENCED_DATA.shows: %{bytes} bytes of the file belong to no box header and no item.
HEIF_UNREFERENCED_DATA.does_not_prove: Free space and padding are allowed by the format; unreferenced data may also be a leftover of an earlier version. Examine it separately.

EXIF_SOFTWARE_EDITOR.title: Saved by editing or processing software
EXIF_SOFTWARE_EDITOR.does_not_prove: Editors are used for legitimate tasks (rotating, resizing, converting); it shows which program saved the file, not what was changed.

XMP_EDIT_HISTORY.title: Edit history in XMP
XMP_EDIT_HISTORY.shows: The XMP history lists %{events} event(s); the last by %{last_agent}.
XMP_EDIT_HISTORY.does_not_prove: The history records software actions (saved, converted, cropped…) as written by the software; it can be incomplete or edited and does not show what the picture looked like before.

METADATA_DATES_INCONSISTENT.title: Metadata dates do not agree
METADATA_DATES_INCONSISTENT.does_not_prove: Clocks, time zones and software that rewrites dates all cause this; it does not show when the picture was taken or changed.

EXIF_DIMENSIONS_MISMATCH.title: Recorded size differs from the real size
EXIF_DIMENSIONS_MISMATCH.shows: The metadata says %{exif} pixels; the image is %{actual}.
EXIF_DIMENSIONS_MISMATCH.does_not_prove: Resizing, cropping and rotation by any program cause this; it does not show what was removed or changed.

METADATA_STRIPPED.title: Little or no camera metadata
METADATA_STRIPPED.shows: The %{format} file carries no camera metadata (no make, model or capture date).
METADATA_STRIPPED.does_not_prove: Messengers, social networks, screenshots and privacy tools remove metadata routinely; its absence says nothing about the content.

MESSENGER_TRACES.title: Traces of a messenger or social network
MESSENGER_TRACES.does_not_prove: These are typical traits, not a signature: other software can produce the same; it does not show who sent the file or that it was changed.

MAKERNOTE_MISSING_FOR_MAKE.title: Manufacturer notes missing
MAKERNOTE_MISSING_FOR_MAKE.shows: The metadata names %{make} but has no MakerNote, which that manufacturer's cameras normally write.
MAKERNOTE_MISSING_FOR_MAKE.does_not_prove: Some phones and firmware versions omit MakerNotes and many programs drop them on save; it does not show the camera claim is false.

METADATA_PROBLEMS.title: Damaged metadata
METADATA_PROBLEMS.shows: The metadata could not be read completely: %{problems}.
METADATA_PROBLEMS.does_not_prove: Software bugs and byte-level edits both damage metadata; it does not show which one happened.

FILE_STRUCTURE_DAMAGED.title: Damaged or truncated file structure
FILE_STRUCTURE_DAMAGED.shows: The file's own structure is damaged: %{problems}. Every readable part was still examined.
FILE_STRUCTURE_DAMAGED.does_not_prove: Interrupted copies or downloads, faulty storage and byte-level edits all damage a file; it does not show which one happened, nor that the image content was changed.

THUMBNAIL_MISMATCH.title: Embedded thumbnail differs from the image
THUMBNAIL_MISMATCH.shows: The small preview stored in the file differs from the main image (%{difference}). A difference image is in maps/thumbnail-diff.png.
THUMBNAIL_MISMATCH.does_not_prove: Programs that edit pixels without regenerating the preview leave the old preview; cropping and rotation also cause differences. It does not show which version is the original or who made the change.

QT_STANDARD_IJG.title: Standard (IJG) compression tables
QT_STANDARD_IJG.shows: The quantization tables are the IJG standard tables at quality %{quality}.
QT_STANDARD_IJG.does_not_prove: Very many programs and devices use these tables; they identify a family of encoders, not one program or camera.

QT_NON_STANDARD.title: Non-standard compression tables
QT_NON_STANDARD.shows: The quantization tables are not IJG standard tables; the nearest IJG quality is %{nearest} (distance %{distance}).
QT_NON_STANDARD.does_not_prove: Cameras and many apps use their own tables; a quality figure for them is only an approximation and is not stated as fact.

QT_MATCHES_EDITOR.title: Compression tables of an editor or app
QT_MATCHES_EDITOR.shows: The quantization tables match %{label} (%{category}) in the %{db} fingerprint database.
QT_MATCHES_EDITOR.does_not_prove: Several programs can share tables and the database is not exhaustive; it shows the last encoder is consistent with that software, not that the content was changed.

QT_MATCHES_DEVICE.title: Compression tables of a known device
QT_MATCHES_DEVICE.shows: The quantization tables match %{label} in the %{db} fingerprint database.
QT_MATCHES_DEVICE.does_not_prove: Tables depend on the phone's operating system and app more than on the hardware, and devices share tables; it is consistent with that source, not proof of it.

QT_UNKNOWN.title: Compression tables not in the database
QT_UNKNOWN.shows: No entry of the fingerprint databases matches these tables (SHA-256 %{hash}).
QT_UNKNOWN.does_not_prove: The database covers few devices and apps; an unknown table says nothing about authenticity. Add known originals with `fingerprints learn`.

QT_INCONSISTENT_WITH_EXIF_MAKE.title: Compression tables do not fit the camera named
QT_INCONSISTENT_WITH_EXIF_MAKE.shows: The metadata names %{make}, but the tables match %{label}, which is not that manufacturer's encoder.
QT_INCONSISTENT_WITH_EXIF_MAKE.does_not_prove: Re-saving with any program replaces the tables while the metadata may stay; it shows the file was re-encoded after capture, not what was changed.

DOUBLE_COMPRESSION_SIGNS.title: Signs of repeated JPEG compression
DOUBLE_COMPRESSION_SIGNS.shows: The DCT coefficient histograms show the periodic pattern left by two successive JPEG compressions (%{components}; strength %{strength}).
DOUBLE_COMPRESSION_SIGNS.does_not_prove: Any re-save — messengers, photo apps, exports — compresses twice; it shows the image was re-encoded at least twice, not that its content was manipulated.

JPEG_GHOST_REGION.title: Region with a different compression history
JPEG_GHOST_REGION.shows: At quality %{quality} a region of about %{area} of the image re-compresses differently from the rest (JPEG ghost map in maps/).
JPEG_GHOST_REGION.does_not_prove: A region pasted from a lower-quality JPEG shows this, but so can smooth or saturated areas; the map needs expert reading and does not by itself prove a paste.

COEFFICIENTS_UNAVAILABLE.title: Compression analysis not possible
COEFFICIENTS_UNAVAILABLE.shows: The DCT coefficients could not be read (%{reason}); the double-compression check was not run.
COEFFICIENTS_UNAVAILABLE.does_not_prove: Nothing is concluded from a check that was not run.

ELA_MAP_WRITTEN.title: Error level map written
ELA_MAP_WRITTEN.shows: An Error Level Analysis map was written to maps/ela.png (re-saved at quality %{quality} with %{encoder}, gain %{gain}).
ELA_MAP_WRITTEN.does_not_prove: ELA highlights edges and textures in authentic images too and cannot identify a change by itself; it is a visual aid for an examiner, never a result.

ELA_NOT_APPLICABLE.title: Error level map not applicable
ELA_NOT_APPLICABLE.shows: The image is %{format} (not JPEG-compressed), so no error level map was made.
ELA_NOT_APPLICABLE.does_not_prove: Nothing is concluded from an analysis that was not applicable.

NOISE_INCONSISTENCY_MAP.title: Noise maps written
NOISE_INCONSISTENCY_MAP.shows: Noise maps were written to maps/ (median residual, and local noise level in %{blocks} blocks: σ from %{sigma_min} to %{sigma_max}).
NOISE_INCONSISTENCY_MAP.does_not_prove: Authentic photos have regions with different noise (sky, shadows, texture); the maps are visual aids that need expert interpretation and are not a result.

COPY_MOVE_CANDIDATE.title: Possible copied-and-moved region
COPY_MOVE_CANDIDATE.shows: %{pairs} pair(s) of matching regions were found, displaced by %{shift} (%{blocks} matching blocks); see maps/copymove.png.
COPY_MOVE_CANDIDATE.does_not_prove: Repetitive patterns (tiles, sky, text, fabric) match by nature; the candidate must be checked visually. Scaled or rotated copies are not detected, so no candidate does not mean no copy.

REFERENCE_INCONSISTENT.title: Differs from the reference images
REFERENCE_INCONSISTENT.shows: Compared with %{n} reference image(s), these properties differ: %{differences}.
REFERENCE_INCONSISTENT.does_not_prove: Settings, firmware and apps change these properties on the same device; a difference does not exclude the device and a match does not prove it.

REFERENCE_CONSISTENT.title: Consistent with the reference images
REFERENCE_CONSISTENT.shows: Compared with %{n} reference image(s), these properties agree: %{compared}.
REFERENCE_CONSISTENT.does_not_prove: Many devices share these properties; consistency does not prove the image comes from the reference device.

HEIC_PIXELS_NOT_DECODED.title: HEIC pixels not analysed
HEIC_PIXELS_NOT_DECODED.shows: The HEIC/HEIF structure and metadata were examined; the pixels were not decoded (%{reason}), so no visual maps or copy-move search were made.
HEIC_PIXELS_NOT_DECODED.does_not_prove: Nothing is concluded from analyses that were not run.

ANALYSIS_SKIPPED_SIZE_CAP.title: Analysis skipped for size
ANALYSIS_SKIPPED_SIZE_CAP.shows: %{analysis} was skipped: the image has %{pixels} pixels, above the cap of %{cap} (--max-pixels).
ANALYSIS_SKIPPED_SIZE_CAP.does_not_prove: Nothing is concluded from an analysis that was not run; raise the cap on a machine with enough memory.

limitations.SIGNATURE_TABLE_LIMITED: Type detection uses a limited table of common file signatures; unknown types are reported as unknown, not as suspicious.
limitations.TIMESTAMPS_FROM_FILESYSTEM: Modification times come from the file system of the examined copy and may differ from the original source.
limitations.CLEAN_RESULT_IS_NOT_AUTHENTICITY: A result without findings does not prove that a file is authentic or unaltered before acquisition.
limitations.TIMESTAMP_PROVES_EXISTENCE_ONLY: A trusted timestamp proves the audit log existed in this exact form at the stated time; it does not prove that the examined copy matches the original source.
limitations.NO_FINDING_IS_NOT_AUTHENTICITY: An image without findings is not proven authentic: careful edits can leave none of the traces these checks look for, and it is impossible to prove a negative (SWGDE 18-I-001).
limitations.FINGERPRINT_DB_COVERAGE: The compression-table database covers few devices and apps (built from Rakvor's own captures plus local learning); an absent or matching entry is weak evidence on its own.
limitations.IMAGE_ANALYSES_PLANNED: In this build the image analyses (metadata and structure checks, quantization-table fingerprints, error level and noise maps, copy-move detection, reference comparison) are planned and not yet implemented: images are hashed, typed and re-read only.
limitations.VISUAL_MAPS_REQUIRE_INTERPRETATION: Error level, noise and ghost maps are visual aids for a trained examiner; the tool gives them no score and draws no conclusion from them.
limitations.DOUBLE_COMPRESSION_IS_NOT_MANIPULATION: Double JPEG compression shows the image was saved more than once; ordinary sharing and exporting do this.
limitations.COPY_MOVE_SCALE_ROTATION_NOT_DETECTED: Copy-move detection compares blocks at the same scale and orientation on a downscaled image: scaled, rotated or small copies are not found.
limitations.NO_VALIDATED_ERROR_RATES_YET: Error rates of these checks have not yet been measured on a documented validation corpus; the findings are signals to be weighed by the examiner.

custody.title_co: Chain of custody record — digital evidence (Colombia)
custody.title_fr: Chain of custody sheet — digital evidence (France)
custody.basis_co: Prepared following Law 906 of 2004 (arts. 254–266), the chain-of-custody manual of the Attorney General's Office (Fiscalía) and Law 527 of 1999.
custody.basis_fr: Prepared for an expert examination under the French Code of Criminal Procedure (arts. 156 ff.); the seal number refers to the judicial seal (scellé).
custody.operation_text: Read-only hashing and analysis by %{tool} %{version}, run %{run_id}, from %{start} to %{end} (UTC). Audit entries #%{first}–#%{last}.
custody.delivered_by: Delivered by (name, position, ID type and number, signature)
custody.received_by: Received by (name, position, ID type and number, signature)
custody.persons_note_co: Every person who handles the item or attends the examination signs here with full name, position (cargo), type and number of identity document (CC, CE, passport) — the identification the Fiscalía custody record asks for.
custody.persons_note_fr: The expert, the persons who assisted the expert and the persons present (witnesses, e.g. at the opening or re-sealing of a seal) sign here with full name, capacity (qualité) and identity document.
